inlines.v: AM'BULATORY, adjective 1. That has the power of faculty of walking; as, an animal is ambulatory 2. Pertaining to a walk; as, an ambulatory view. 3. Moving from place to place; not stationary; as, an ambulatory court, which exercises its jurisdiction in different places. AM'BULATORY, noun a species of ichneumon, with a yellowish scutellum and spotted thorax.
